title: Menu covers & dining
description: Menu covers, bill presenters and coordinated tabletop accessories for restaurants, hotels and clubs. A shared identity from the menu to the bill.

title.html: The first impression. The finishing touch.

body.html: Menu covers, bill presenters and coordinated tabletop accessories for restaurants, hotels and clubs. A shared identity from the menu to the bill.

media.alt: Burgundy menu cover and bill presenter beside an olive placemat in a restaurant.

body.html: From opening the menu to presenting the bill, your tabletop accessories accompany the visit. We specify menu covers, placemats, coasters and bill presenters entirely around your service. Genuine Italian leather, high-quality PU in many colours and finishes, and other model-specific coverings give the collection its own feel and identity.
A considered foundation for your table setting. Shape, proportions and finish are selected around the table, tableware and service routine.
Your menu deserves a considered presentation. Selected bindings and materials connect your restaurant’s character with the requirements of service.

media.alt: Detail of screw-post binding in an SFP menu cover

body.html: A considered final touch to service. Bill presentation can echo the materials and colours of your menu covers and tabletop accessories.

media.alt: Closed branded bill folder — product photograph with an edited setting

body.html: A small but visible part of the table setting. Dimensions and finish are considered alongside glassware, placemats and your material scheme.

media.alt: Round and square coasters in different materials — product photograph with an edited setting

body.html: Choose from genuine Italian leather, high-quality PU and other materials available for the product. We use samples to agree colour, finish and construction for your accessory.
Blind debossing presses the design into the surface without colour. Foil stamping adds a coloured or metallic finish. We agree the method, size and position to suit the material.
Find individual models, material choices and specification options in our complete accessory collection.
